left.text: The index uses a split-flap display: two tickers cycle the word for news through fifteen languages above and below the headline. The changelog is a horizontal strip of release cards. Below the changelog, posts are listed in a card grid and filtered by four categories: Engineering, Craft, Community, and News.

right.caption: The blog index runs the two tickers above and below the headline, sets the changelog strip between two registration crosses on the left rail, and starts the post grid under the category filter.
